title: Validate successful LTE attach and detach with single UE under excellent radio conditions
description: Verify that a single UE can successfully perform LTE attach and detach procedures 10 consecutive times with 100% success rate, under excellent radio conditions in an isolated single cell environment.
preconditions: Test setup configured as single isolated LTE cell with all other cells powered off.
UE (real or emulated) placed at cell center under excellent LTE RSRP conditions as defined in Clause 4.6.
End-to-end LTE setup operational with no connectivity issues.
testSteps: Configure test setup according to test configuration and record parameters.
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE to trigger LTE attach procedure.
Wait for attach complete message confirming successful attach.
Validate UE is attached to correct LTE cell by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN in UE logs.
Power OFF the UE to trigger LTE detach procedure.
Wait for detach accept message confirming successful detach.
Stop and save logs.
Repeat steps 3 to 8 for total of 10 iterations.
Measure and record attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency (min, avg, max) for all iterations.
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations.
Detach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations.
Attach latency measured and recorded with no anomalies.
Logs confirm proper attach and detach signaling flows according to 3GPP TS 23.401 clauses.
UE correctly attached to configured LTE cell in all iterations.
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs for attach/detach messages and cell parameters.
Review signaling logs for attach request/complete and detach request/accept messages.
Check latency calculations from attach request to attach complete timestamps.

title: Validate successful 5G NSA attach and detach with single UE under excellent radio conditions
description: Verify that a single UE can successfully perform 5G NSA attach and detach procedures 10 consecutive times with 100% success rate, including secondary node addition and release, under excellent radio conditions in an isolated single cell environment.
preconditions: Test setup configured as single isolated cell with LTE and 5G NSA capabilities; all other cells powered off.
UE (real or emulated) placed at cell center under excellent 5G SS-RSRP conditions as defined in Clause 4.6.
End-to-end 5G NSA setup operational with no connectivity issues.
testSteps: Configure test setup according to test configuration and record parameters.
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE to trigger LTE initial attach and 5G secondary node addition.
Wait for attach complete and secondary node addition complete messages confirming successful attach and EN-DC setup.
Validate UE is attached to correct LTE and 5G cells by checking PCI, Global eNB ID/Global gNB, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN in UE logs.
Power OFF the UE to trigger LTE detach and 5G secondary node release procedures.
Wait for detach accept and secondary node release confirmation messages.
Stop and save logs.
Repeat steps 3 to 8 for total of 10 iterations.
Measure and record attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, detach success rate for all iterations.
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations.
Secondary node addition success rate is 100% over 10 iterations.
Detach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations.
Logs confirm proper attach, secondary node addition, detach, and secondary node release signaling flows according to 3GPP TS 23.401 and TS 37.340 clauses.
UE correctly attached to configured LTE and 5G NSA cells in all iterations.
postconditions: UE detached from LTE and 5G NSA cells.
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs for attach, secondary node addition, and detach messages.
Review signaling logs for attach request/complete, SgNB addition request/reconfiguration complete, detach request/accept and SgNB release messages.
Validate that secondary node release is confirmed by SgNB Release Request Acknowledge or equivalent.

title: Negative test: Verify attach failure handling when radio conditions degrade below excellent threshold
description: Verify that attach procedure fails or retries appropriately when LTE or 5G NSA radio conditions degrade below the defined excellent RSRP/SS-RSRP thresholds during attach attempts.
preconditions: Test setup configured as single isolated cell with UE placed under good but not excellent radio conditions, below Clause 4.6 thresholds.
End-to-end LTE or 5G NSA setup operational.
testSteps: Configure test setup and record parameters.
Start logging.
Power ON the UE to trigger attach procedure.
Observe attach request and attach complete messages or failure messages.
Record attach success or failure and retry attempts.
Power OFF UE.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: Attach procedure either fails gracefully or retries according to implementation.
Attach success rate is below 100%, attach latency may increase.
Logs capture failure causes or retry signaling.
System does not crash or hang due to bad radio conditions.
postconditions: UE detached or in initial state.
verificationMethods: Review signaling logs for attach failure or retry messages.
Check UE logs for attach failure reasons.
Verify system stability during failure conditions.

title: Negative test: Verify detach failure handling due to missing detach accept message
description: Verify system behavior when the detach accept message is not received by the UE during detach procedure, simulating network signaling failure.
preconditions: Test setup configured for LTE or 5G NSA attach and detach.
UE successfully attached to cell.
testSteps: Start logging.
Power OFF UE to initiate detach.
Simulate or force network to drop detach accept message or delay beyond timeout.
Observe UE and network behavior.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: UE retries detach procedure or enters fallback state as per implementation.
No resource leaks on network side.
System logs error or timeout events related to missing detach accept.
Detach success rate recorded as less than 100% if applicable.
postconditions: UE state consistent post detach attempt.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for missing detach accept and retry procedures.
Check UE state and network resource release.
Validate error handling and recovery.

title: Edge case test: Attach and detach with signal strength at minimum coupling loss limit
description: Verify that the UE can perform attach and detach procedures successfully when radio conditions are at the exact minimum coupling loss threshold defined in Clause 4.6.
preconditions: Test setup configured with variable attenuator/fading generator to precisely set radio conditions at minimum coupling loss.
UE placed inside RF shielded environment or connected via cable as required.
testSteps: Configure test setup to achieve minimum coupling loss radio conditions.
Start logging.
Power ON UE and perform attach procedure.
Wait for successful attach confirmation.
Power OFF UE and perform detach procedure.
Wait for successful detach confirmation.
Repeat attach-detach procedure 10 times.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rate remains at 100%.
Attach latency may increase but within acceptable limits.
No unexpected failures due to edge radio conditions.
Logs confirm successful signaling flows.
postconditions: UE detached and test environment reset.
verificationMethods: Measure attach and detach success rates.
Verify latency statistics against baseline.
Review logs for signaling correctness.

title: Performance test: Measure attach and detach latency and success rate over 10 iterations
description: Measure and analyze the attach latency (min, average, max), attach success rate, and detach success rate for 10 consecutive attach-detach cycles under excellent radio conditions for LTE and 5G NSA.
preconditions: Test setup configured as per LTE or 5G NSA single UE scenario.
UE placed at cell center with excellent radio conditions.
testSteps: Start detailed logging including timestamps for attach request and attach complete.
Power ON UE to trigger attach; record attach latency.
Power OFF UE to trigger detach; record detach success.
Repeat for 10 iterations.
Calculate min, average, and max attach latency.
Record attach and detach success rates.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are 100%.
Attach latency values are within expected thresholds.
No excessive variation in latency across iterations.
Logs provide detailed timing and signaling information.
verificationMethods: Timestamp analysis of attach request and attach complete messages.
Success/failure message counts.
Statistical analysis of latency data.

title: Security test: Validate attach and detach procedures with unauthorized UE
description: Verify that a UE without proper authentication credentials cannot successfully perform attach procedure and is rejected by the network.
preconditions: Test setup configured for LTE or 5G NSA.
UE configured with invalid or missing authentication credentials.
testSteps: Power ON unauthorized UE to initiate attach.
Monitor network authentication and attach signaling messages.
Observe network rejection or failure messages.
Attempt detach procedure if attach partially succeeds.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails due to authentication rejection.
Unauthorized UE does not access network services.
Detach procedure either not required or handled appropriately.
Logs capture authentication failure messages.
verificationMethods: Analyze authentication signaling messages.
Check UE and network attach status.
Verify no unauthorized access granted.

title: Integration test: Verify coordination between MN and SN during secondary node release procedure
description: Verify the signaling flow and coordination between Master Node (MN) and Secondary Node (SN) during Secondary Node Release procedure initiated by MN and SN, including data forwarding and resource release.
preconditions: Test setup with 5G NSA cells configured with MN and SN.
UE attached with active secondary node.
testSteps: Initiate SN Release procedure from MN side by sending SgNB Release Request.
Verify SN sends SgNB Release Request Acknowledge.
Observe RRCConnectionReconfiguration message indicating SCG release to UE.
Check SN sends SN Status Transfer message and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report.
Verify UE Context Release message reception and resource release at SN.
Repeat with SN initiated SN Release by sending SgNB Release Required message.
Verify MN sends SgNB Release Confirm message and data forwarding starts.
Validate proper coordination and signaling flows in both cases.
Capture logs for analysis.
expectedResults: All signaling messages exchanged as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1.
SCG configuration released on UE correctly.
Data forwarding coordinated without service gaps.
Resources released properly at SN.
No signaling errors or message rejections unless SN triggers reject due to SN change procedure.
postconditions: Test environment reset for next procedure.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling message flows between MN and SN.
Check UE logs for SCG release confirmation.
Validate data forwarding start and completion messages.
Review resource release confirmation.

title: Usability test: Verify clarity and completeness of test logging and reporting procedures
description: Evaluate the ease of configuring the test setup, starting/stopping log capture, and generating reports for attach-detach test procedures.
preconditions: Test environment with logging and reporting tools available.
testSteps: Configure test according to documented parameters and record configuration.
Start log capture with clear commands or interface actions.
Perform attach-detach test cycles.
Stop log capture and save logs.
Generate test report including KPIs and gap analysis.
Review documentation and UI for clarity and user guidance.
expectedResults: Test setup and logging commands are simple and intuitive.
Logs are complete and correctly associated with test iterations.
Test report clearly presents KPIs, success rates, and latency data.
Gap analysis is easy to interpret.
Users can repeat tests without ambiguity.
postconditions: Logs and reports stored for reference.
verificationMethods: User feedback on test procedure steps.
Review of log file completeness and format.
Assessment of report quality and clarity.

title: Compatibility test: Verify attach-detach test procedure across different UE models and firmware versions
description: Ensure that the attach and detach procedures execute successfully on a variety of UE devices with different models and firmware versions under the same test setup.
preconditions: Test setup configured for LTE and 5G NSA attach-detach testing.
Multiple UE devices of different models and firmware versions available.
testSteps: For each UE model and firmware version:
Configure and record test parameters.
Place UE under excellent radio conditions.
Start logging.
Perform 10 attach-detach cycles as per standard procedure.
Stop and save logs.
Compare KPIs and success rates across UE devices.
expectedResults: All tested UE devices achieve 100% attach and detach success rates.
Attach latency within expected range for each device.
No device-specific failures or anomalies.
Test logs confirm correct signaling and attach to correct cells.
postconditions: Test data stored for compatibility analysis.
verificationMethods: Cross-device KPI comparison.
Log analysis for device-specific issues.
Firmware version correlation with performance.
